# CI workflows

- Pin third-party actions to a commit SHA, not a moving tag.
- Declare least-privilege `permissions:` at the workflow level. Default to `contents: read`.
- Never combine `pull_request_target` with a checkout of the head ref — that gives fork code
  access to your secrets.
- Secrets are referenced, never echoed. No `run: echo ${{ secrets.X }}`, no printing environment
  dumps.
- A workflow that can write to the repository or publish an artifact needs an explicit reason in
  the PR description.
- Keep the build reproducible: pin runtime versions, use lockfile-respecting install commands
  (`npm ci`, not `npm install`).
